# What the Pages workflow installs to build the site: pytest, which
# scripts/site_facts.py needs to import tests/test_symmetry.py and count the
# tests. Every package is pinned by hash, and installed with --no-deps, so
# nothing unpinned runs in the job that builds the published site.
# Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) opens a pull request for each update.
